title: Kotaro Makaritoru! Vol. 48 Chinese Edition Manga Book by Tatsuya Hiruta
categoryName: Collectibles:Comic Books & Memorabilia:Manga & Asian Comics:Single Volumes
descriptionText:
Description:
Item: This is a Chinese-language edition of the manga series "Kotaro Makaritoru!" (功夫旋風兒).
Volume: Volume 48.
Authors: The original author is Tatsuya Hiruta (蛭田達也), and the Chinese translator is listed as Zhang Meizhu (張美珠).
Publisher: Published as part of the TLC Officially Licensed Chinese Edition Youth Series (TLC正式授權中文版少年系列).
Condition: Please refer to the photos for the exact condition of the book. The pictures show the actual item you will receive.
